title: U.S. pulls diplomats from Saudi Arabia as it reportedly readies Iran strikes after midterms
summary_full: The U.S. ordered non-emergency staff out of Saudi Arabia after Houthi strikes on an airport and an oil field, reviving fears of a widening regional conflict.
summary_public: The U.S. ordered non-emergency staff out of Saudi Arabia after Houthi strikes on an airport and an oil field, reviving fears of a widening regional conflict.
